source.note: The six core values below are fixed brand foundations. Any additional surface/component colors must be derived and centrally tokenized, never scattered as ad-hoc literals.

accentNeutral.role: neutral/light accent; primary light text on dark surfaces

accentSignal.role: orange brand/action accent; on orange fills use #0E1015 text

textOnColor.role: text on colorful surfaces, including the orange accent

contrastChecks.note: Ratios use the exact solid sRGB core colors. Recheck actual composites, opacity, imagery and hover/focus states after implementation.

systemRules: Keep the core palette values unchanged unless the owner explicitly changes them.
Build a hierarchy of primitive tokens, semantic tokens, and component tokens; components should consume semantic/component tokens rather than hard-coded hex values.

Individual modules and finished components may have distinct surface treatments or additional colors, but every addition must be named, centrally defined, accessible, and consistent with the site-wide system.
Use #0E1015 for text on light and colorful surfaces; use #EEEEEE for text on dark surfaces.
Do not place #EEEEEE text on #FF5F01 fills; use #0E1015 for readable contrast.
Use the orange accent with intent; preserve enough neutral space for hierarchy.
The current Line Launcher logo asset uses a warm-white fill; preserve source brand assets unless the owner separately approves a logo change.
